notes.title: Update 1.1.4
notes.content:
- Added a threat level cap to each wormhole based on the distance from the start
 - Changed the threat level increase from killing hostiles to be less so that it takes longer to reach the cap.

notes.title: Hotfix 12
notes.content:
- Bugfix - If you change the colour of adjacent wormhole on the map, it will now update the connection as well.
 - Bugfix - Fixed an issue with cancelling planned routes.
 - Bugfix - If you save in a combat instance all data is now saved so you can reload inside a combat instance.
 - Bugfix - Fixed an issue where after respawn the station types would sometimes change.

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Release Day
notes.content:
1.1 - Content Update

 - Added Basic, Advanced and Elite scanner modules.
 - Added Fog of War that can be cleared with scanners.
 - Added setting to stop Fog of War regenrating.
 - Added Nebula wormholes that render scanner modules useless while in the wormhole.
 - Added a ship hanger at home station after docking unlocked.
 - Added a feature to allow the removal of modules/weapon and leave the slot empty.
 - Added Explorer class ships.
 - Added Hauler class ships.
 - Added Dronebay module to allow you to store drones ready for launch during combat.
 - Added Combat, Defence and Repair drones to assist you in combat.
 - Added setting to change save frequency.
 - Added hover panel for Lootpods to see thier contents.
 - Added a system to generate a limited amount of loops within the map.
 - Bug Fix - if you are on a station docking ring on load, it will now show the dock button.
 - Bug Fix - Dock button will now show after respawn or recovery.
 - Bug Fix - added new logic to the hover panels to stop them appearing behind the mouse and flickering.
 - Bug Fix - Hover panels will now correctly resize to the text they contain.
 - Bug Fix - If you fast travel to a location on planned route, route will be replanned from new location.
 - Bug Fix - If you end turn before the hostile death animation is finished it will no longer bug out the next hostile.
 _ Changed the game over panel to show the seed, if permadeath and the FOW setting.
 - Changed the available mission header to show the current mission level and the number of missions to the next level.
 - Changed the hover panel to show how many station cargo slots are used.
 - Changed the hover panel to show information relevent to the scanner level.
 - Changed the map to only show connection that you have uncovered from the Fog of War.
 - Changed the map hover panel to only show things you have uncovered from the Fog of War.
 - Changed ship and station storage to be sorted by item type and then by item name.
 - Changed the settings for dead space generation for the map to make smaller areas, that are more scattered.
 - Changed the ore distribution so there is a small chance to get lithium and uranium sooner.
 - Hostile ships will now only activate once they are within scanner range.
 - Hostile ship spawns will spawn higher tier ships before lower tier at higher threat wormholes.
 - Enabled save conflict correction for ships from old version saves.

notes.title: Update 1.1 is coming soon
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers, 

Firstly I would like to thank everyone that has purchased the game and extra thanks to all that have left a review or giving me feedback directly, the reviews and feedback are what have driven this update to improve the game and I am very excited to now confirm the upcoming update will be released on April 3rd at 1300 hrs(UTC).

Most of the update is now complete with 1 more major task which is improving the AI combat tactics which I hope to have completed next week, Below I have included the change log so far, this will give you a good idea of what to expect, With all these new update a new trailer will be made and published before release so look out for that also.

Please let me know what you are most excited about in the coming update

1.1 - Content Update Change Log

 - Added Basic, Advanced and Elite scanner modules.
 - Added Fog of War that can be cleared with scanners.
 - Added setting to stop Fog of War regenerating.
 - Added Nebula wormholes that render scanner modules useless while in the wormhole.
 - Added a ship hanger at home station after docking unlocked.
 - Added a feature to allow the removal of modules/weapon and leave the slot empty.
 - Added Explorer class ships.
 - Added Hauler class ships.
 - Added Drone bay modules to allow you to store drones ready for launch during combat.
 - Added Combat, Defence and Repair drones to assist you in combat.
 - Added setting to change save frequency.
 - Added hover panel for Loot pods to see their contents.
 - Bug Fix - if you are on a station docking ring on load, it will now show the dock button.
 - Bug Fix - Dock button will now show after re-spawn or recovery.
 - Bug Fix - added new logic to the hover panels to stop them appearing behind the mouse and flickering.
 - Bug Fix - Hover panels will now correctly resize to the text they contain.
 - Changed the hover panel to show information relevant to the scanner level.
 - Changed ship and station storage to be sorted by item type and then by item name.
 - Hostile ships will now only activate once they are within scanner range.
 - Hostile ship spawns will spawn higher tier ships before lower tier at higher threat wormholes.
 - Enabled save conflict correction for ships from old version saves.

notes.title: Hotfix 11
notes.content: - Fixed an issue where if you undocked and instantly docked again it would treat it as the player station.

notes.title: Hotfix 10
notes.content:
- Fixed issue where dropping loot on your beacon would stop you ever docking again.
 - Fixed the issue where a delivery mission from the player station wouldn't remove from available list.
 - You can no longer go into debt taking delivery missions.
 - If hostile dies on scrap, the scrap will now be added to the lootpod.
 - Crafting list now in alphabetical order.
 - Changed formatting for save names so that longer names use a smaller font size.
 - Increased the stack size of bed to 10 from 1.
 - Increased the stack size of chair to 20 from 5.
 - Reduced the amount of display screens and replicators in the final stage to 50.

notes.title: Hotfix 9
notes.content:
Hotfix 9

 - Your can no longer buy more fuel from a station that your ship can carry.
 - Fixed an issue that meant you could hand a delivery mission in without the required items.
 - Added a mine button so that you can mine from lootpod panel if lootpos on asteroid.

notes.title: Hotfix 8
notes.content:
- Fixed the issue of incorrect pixel perfect camera size when going from windowed to fullscreen, and vice versa.
 - Corrected a spelling error in Exploring space missions.
 - When docked and viewing missions, complete ones now show green and incomplete ones show orange.

notes.title: Hotfix 7
notes.content:
Hotfix 7

 - Increased the maps click & drag area.
 - Changed when UI hover panel will change position based on mouse position.
 - Change the central UI to say "press ESCAPE to stop mining" when mining.
 - When entering freeroam in a wormhole, any missions for that wormhole now move to the top of the list in the right mission display.
 - Added panel to view change log in game.

notes.title: Hotfix 6
notes.content:
Hotfix 6

 - Fixed a issue of hostiles still rotating when not needed.
 - HUD panel frame now remains active when closing HUD.
 - HUD now opens and closes as same speed irrelevant of framerate.
 - Updated the settings panel to stop the confirm new settings appearing when opening.
 - Fixed a issue when restarting universe you would still have some fast travel timer from previous run.
 - Fixed a issue where after dying in a combat instance you would damage yourself after respawn.
 - Added 3 new station names.
 - Corrected a spelling error on game over screen.
 - Added rebuild station achievement.

notes.title: Hotfix 5
notes.content:
Hotfix 5

 - Fixed an issue where the map was clipping on drag
 - Added missing audio slider for ship explosions
 - Fixed hostile rotation issues that causes them to spin and face the wrong direction.

notes.title: Hotfix 4
notes.content:
Hotfix 4

 - Fixed an issue with the pixel perfect camera not remembering settings.
 - Corrected some spelling errors in missions.

notes.title: Hotfix 3
notes.content:
Hotfix 3

 - Add Note in hover panel about Buy/Sell all.
 - Added new introduction on spawn.
 - Added some extra protection to stop animation of ship being in the wrong rotation.

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.content:
Hotfix 2

 - Changed audio settings to show blue to the left of slider.
 - Added a hover panel to asteroids to show type and remaining.
 - Added total mined to combat log.
 - Added mouse drag to map screen.
 - crafting recipes with some available resources now show yellow.

notes.title: Hotfix 1
notes.content:
Hotfix 1

 - Fixed issue where after tutorial some UI elements were still active.
 - fixed some spelling errors.
 - stopped game saving on death, so you can now reload from your last save.
 - you can now press escape to close settings panel.
 - End turn now flashes when you have no moves left during combat.
 - shields now show recharged when existing combat.
 - Player and hostile ships can now traverse scrap and lootpods.
